ENV=os.environ|{'DEVELOPER_DIR':'/Applications/Xcode-beta.app/Contents/Developer','CARGO_TARGET_DIR':str(ROOT/'target'),'CARGO_BUILD_WARNINGS':'deny','CARGO_BUILD_JOBS':'2','RUSTC_WRAPPER':'','CARGO_INCREMENTAL':'0','FINCODE_COMMIT_SHA':SHA,'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0','CI':'true'}
os.umask(0o077);steps=[];child=None;terminal=False;code=1

def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(P(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def gone(pid):
 try:os.killpg(pid,0);return False
 except ProcessLookupError:return True

def clean():
 assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True,timeout=10).strip()==SHA
 assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','--no-optional-locks','status','--porcelain'],cwd=ROOT,text=True,timeout=10).strip()
def save():
 (OUT/('results.json'if INNER else'queue.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'source':SHA,'root':str(ROOT),'terminal':terminal,'exitCode':code if terminal else None,'steps':steps,'helperSha256':digest(__file__),'scope':'Native Mac desktop_media library compile and strict Clippy after common admitted-host extraction; dependency guard. No Windows app compile/execution or provider integration, capture or performance evidence.'},indent=2)+'\n')
def stop():
 global child
 if child is not None and not gone(child.pid):
  os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
  try:child.wait(timeout=4)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:pass
  if not gone(child.pid):
   os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
  child.wait(timeout=4)
def interrupt(a,b):raise KeyboardInterrupt()
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,interrupt);signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,interrupt)
def run(name,command,deadline):
 global child
 clean();log=OUT/(name+'.log');started=time.monotonic()
 with log.open('w')as f:
  child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=ROOT,env=ENV,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
  timed=False
  try:exitcode=child.wait(timeout=deadline)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:timed=True;stop();exitcode=124
  stop()
 clean();steps.append({'name':name,'command':command,'deadlineSeconds':deadline,'exitCode':exitcode,'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'pgid':child.pid,'groupGone':gone(child.pid),'logSha256':digest(log),'timedOut':timed,'sourceCleanBefore':True,'sourceCleanAfter':True});save();print(name,exitcode,flush=True);assert gone(child.pid);child=None;assert exitcode==0
try:
 if not INNER:run('queue',['/usr/bin/lockf','-k','-t','45','/tmp/fincode-build.lock','/usr/bin/nice','-n','19',sys.executable,__file__,'--inside-lock'],2100)
 else:
  run('load',['/usr/bin/uptime'],10)

  run('check',['cargo','check','--locked','-p','desktop_media','-p','environment_host','--lib','-j2','-q','--message-format=short'],900)

  run('test-build',['cargo','test','--locked','-p','desktop_media','--lib','--no-run','-j2','-q','--message-format=short'],600)

  run('test-clippy',['cargo','clippy','--locked','-p','desktop_media','--lib','--tests','-j2','-q','--message-format=short','--','-D','warnings'],600)
  run('dependency-guard',['bash','scripts/check-workspace-deps.sh'],45)
